ni_takahashi_microkinetic.composition: 30 wt% Ni/MgO, impregnation, calcined 600 degC, 22-42 mesh powder
ni_takahashi_microkinetic.experimental_basis: Lab fixed-bed quartz reactor, 1 atm, Ar balance, H2 yield by GC-TCD; catalyst mass not reported; SV 15000-30000 h^-1
ni_takahashi_microkinetic.label: Ni/MgO microkinetic (Takahashi & Fujitani 2016)
limitations: Steps 2 and 3 irreversible in the source: rate does not vanish at equilibrium (AmCraX approach factor optional, see below).
Mole-fraction basis: no intrinsic total-pressure dependence; use at 20 bar is an unvalidated extrapolation.
Nomenclature lists T in degC; T in K reproduces Table 2 (used here).
Table 1 reproduces Table 2 at 500 degC only within 2-7 % (paper rounding); not tuned.

Ea4.locator: Table 1 (k4; also used for K4, Eq. 25)

ni_takahashi_microkinetic.pressure_basis: mole fractions p_i/p_total (atm in the source; ratio is unit free)
ni_takahashi_microkinetic.rate_law_text: Elementary steps NH3+s<=>NH3(a) (k1, k-1=k1/K1); NH3(a)+3s->N(a)+3H(a) (k2, irreversible); 2N(a)->N2+2s (k3, irreversible); 2H(a)<=>H2+2s (k4, k-4=k4/K4). r1=k1*(pNH3/ptot)*th_s - k-1*th_NH3; r2=k2*th_NH3*th_s^3; r3=k3*th_N^2; r4=k4*th_H^2 - k-4*(pH2/ptot)*th_s^2; th_s=1-th_NH3-th_N-th_H; QSS r1=r2, r2=2r3, 3r2=2r4; r_NH3 = r2 [mol s-1 g-1]. k_i=A_i exp(-Ea_i/RT), k1=A1 (Ea1=0); K1=A5 exp(-Ea5/RT); K4=A6 exp(-Ea4/RT).

validity.note: fit 350-450 degC, X<20 %, 1 atm; validated 500-650 degC at 1 atm (Figs. 1, 3, 5)

rho_cat_kg_m3.locator: Table 1; used as (1-eps_b)*rho_cat in Table 2 mass balance, i.e. particle density

equilibrium_constant.assumption_text: dGr is read as J per 2 mol NH3 (2NH3 -> N2 + 3H2), verified against Cantera gri30 to <0.5 kJ (research synthesis check). The driving force of Eq. 2 vanishes at equilibrium only if Keq^2 = exp(-dGr/RT) (Keq per mol NH3, 1 bar standard state). AmCraX therefore uses Keq^2 = exp(-dGr/(R*T)).
equilibrium_constant.options: keq_basis='published' (Eq. 4 with the above reading) or 'amcrax_thermo' (Kp from amcrax.thermodynamics, NASA7/GRI-Mech 3.0)
equilibrium_constant.published: Keq = exp(-dGr/(R*T)); dGr = 95117 - 193.67*T - 0.035293*T^2 + 9.22e-6*T^3 (Eqs. 3-4, p. 4; unit of dGr not printed)

ru_kum_temkin_pyzhev.experimental_basis: Kinetic fit by kum2026heatintegrated to experimental data of dicarlo2014ammonia (commercial Ru/Al2O3)
ru_kum_temkin_pyzhev.label: Ru/Al2O3 Temkin-Pyzhev (Kum et al. 2026, fit to Di Carlo et al. 2014)
limitations: Keq basis ambiguous in the source; AmCraX reading is an assumption (see equilibrium_constant).
Extrapolation above 723 K and above 10 bar is unvalidated.
Rate is singular at P_H2 -> 0; the PFR starts from a small H2 seed (numerical assumption).
Nomenclature lists R in m3 bar/(mol K); J/(mol K) is required because Ea is in J/mol.
ru_kum_temkin_pyzhev.rate_law_text: r = ko*exp(-Ea/(R*T)) * [ (P_NH3^2/P_H2^3)^beta - (P_N2/Keq^2)*(P_H2^3/P_NH3^2)^(1-beta) ], P in bar, r in mol g_cat^-1 s^-1 (per mol NH3)

validity.note: fit to 36 points of dicarlo2014ammonia, GHSV 300-2400 h^-1, MAPE 0.81 % (p. 9); source applies it up to 773 K / 13 bar

ru_takahashi_microkinetic.composition: 5 wt% Ru/MgO, impregnation (RuCl3), calcined 600 degC, 22-42 mesh powder
ru_takahashi_microkinetic.experimental_basis: Lab fixed-bed quartz reactor, 1 atm, Ar balance; catalyst mass not reported; SV 15000-30000 h^-1
ru_takahashi_microkinetic.label: Ru/MgO microkinetic (Takahashi & Fujitani 2016)
limitations: Steps 2 and 3 irreversible: equilibrium approach factor is an AmCraX extension.
Mole-fraction basis: no total-pressure dependence; 20 bar use is extrapolation.
N2 recombinative desorption is rate limiting on Ru (pp. 6-7).
ru_takahashi_microkinetic.rate_law_text: Same elementary-step model as ni_takahashi_microkinetic with Ru parameters (Table 1).

validity.note: fit 300-400 degC, X<20 %, 1 atm; validated 450-550 degC at 1 atm (Figs. 2, 4, 5)

equilibrium_approach_factor.expression: r_AmCraX = r_published * (1 - Q/Kp),  Q = y_N2^0.5 * y_H2^1.5 * (P/1 bar) / y_NH3,  Kp from amcrax.thermodynamics
equilibrium_approach_factor.label: assumption (AmCraX extension)
equilibrium_approach_factor.rationale: The published microkinetic model omits the reverse of steps 2 and 3 (valid at 1 atm, far from equilibrium at the authors' conditions). At 20 bar the cracked gas approaches equilibrium, and an irreversible law would predict conversion above equilibrium. The factor forces r -> 0 at equilibrium; it is switchable (approach_factor=False).

rho_apparent_kg_m3.locator: Sec. 2.4 (single value reported for the kinetic analysis)

nire_ceo2_2p5ni0p5ru_lucentini_lhhw.composition: Ni 2.39 wt%, Ru 0.35 wt% (ICP-MS) on nanopolycrystalline CeO2, co-impregnation, calcined 450 degC; powder, d_cat 0.10 mm, diluted in SiC
nire_ceo2_2p5ni0p5ru_lucentini_lhhw.label: 2.5Ni0.5Ru/CeO2 LHHW (Lucentini et al. 2021)
limitations: Irreversible as published: AmCraX equilibrium approach factor applied by default (switchable).
Fitted at 1 atm only; K1, K4 temperature independent; extrapolation above 1 atm unvalidated.
Initial deactivation of about 2 % over 100 h at 450 degC (p. 12) is not modelled.
Blank conversion 4/9/24 % at 400/450/500 degC (p. 10), subtraction not stated.
Powder intrinsic kinetics; no effectiveness factor.
nire_ceo2_2p5ni0p5ru_lucentini_lhhw.pressure_basis: molar concentrations C_i = p_i/(R T) in mol m^-3
nire_ceo2_2p5ni0p5ru_lucentini_lhhw.rate_law_text: Same LHHW expression as nire_ceo2_5ni1ru_lucentini_lhhw (Eq. 17) with the 2.5Ni0.5Ru/CeO2 parameters of Table 3.

validity.note: fitted 350-550/600 degC, 1 atm; the source itself simulates pure NH3 at 1 atm (Fig. 10); above 1 atm is extrapolation

eps_av_catalyst_only.locator: Sec. 2.4, Eq. 6 (bed of catalyst particles only, d_i 4.572 mm)

nire_ceo2_5ni1ru_lucentini_lhhw.composition: Ni 4.98 wt%, Ru 0.64 wt% (ICP-MS) on nanopolycrystalline CeO2, co-impregnation, calcined 450 degC; powder, d_cat 0.10 mm, diluted in SiC
nire_ceo2_5ni1ru_lucentini_lhhw.experimental_basis: 0.1 g powder in SiC (bed 0.41 cm3), stainless-steel tube d_i 4.572 mm, 1 atm, isothermal PFR fit (Eqs. 2-4), MS analysis (+/-5 %)
nire_ceo2_5ni1ru_lucentini_lhhw.label: 5Ni1Ru/CeO2 LHHW (Lucentini et al. 2021)
limitations: Irreversible as published: the AmCraX equilibrium approach factor (1 - Q/Kp) is applied by default (switchable).
Fitted at 1 atm only; K1 and K4 are temperature independent; total-pressure dependence enters only through concentrations (extrapolation above 1 atm unvalidated).
Blank (empty reactor / SiC / CeO2) conversion was 4, 9 and 24 % at 400, 450, 500 degC (p. 10); the paper does not state that blank activity was subtracted.
Gas-volume reference conditions of the mL min^-1 flows are not stated (AmCraX assumes 0 degC, 1 atm; 25 degC tested as sensitivity).
Powder (0.1 mm) intrinsic kinetics: industrial pellets need an effectiveness factor (not modelled).
nire_ceo2_5ni1ru_lucentini_lhhw.pressure_basis: molar concentrations C_i = p_i/(R T) in mol m^-3
nire_ceo2_5ni1ru_lucentini_lhhw.rate_law_text: r = k*K1*C_NH3 / (1 + K1*C_NH3 + sqrt(C_H2/K4))^2, k = k0*exp(-Ek/(R*T)); C_i in mol m^-3, r in mol NH3 g_cat^-1 s^-1. Rate-determining step: first dehydrogenation NH3(a)+s -> NH2(a)+H(a) (Eq. 9); N2 desorption irreversible, H2 adsorption quasi-equilibrated (Eqs. 8-13). K1 and K4 are temperature independent as published (Table 3). Irreversible as published.

validity.note: fitted 350-550/600 degC, 1 atm, NH3 10-100 % in Ar (F/W 15-45 L g^-1 h^-1, H2 co-feed 0-67.5 %); every use above 1 atm is extrapolation

dicarlo_ru_al2o3_500C.note: Kum's rate law was fitted to Di Carlo data, so this is a consistency check, not independent validation; 773 K is above the 723 K fit range
